run_with_substituted_path: run a program with the PATH environment variable replaced by the value of SUBST_PATH
run_subprocess_with_args: run a subprocess with command line arguments and return its exit code
handle_signal_exit_code: handle negative exit codes from signal-terminated processes by returning 100 instead
review_main_function: review the main function that substitutes PATH and launches a subprocess with sys.argv arguments
summarize_run_with_path: summarize the script that overrides PATH using SUBST_PATH and runs a program with substituted environment
